answer.text:
According to Levi Strauss & Co.'s Consolidated Financial Statements and Item 7 (MD&A) in its Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 1, 2024:

* **Selling, general and administrative (SG&A) expenses:** **$3,246.2 million** (accession: `0000094845-25-000005`, section: `Filing Summary`, chunk IDs: `ecb0b5b4-2adc-54cc-802a-77c3d77ffbc4` and `7800a9af-162a-5e50-b146-b4ba64b4b763`).
* **Percentage of net revenues:** **51.1%** (accession: `0000094845-25-000005`, section: `Filing Summary`, chunk ID: `7800a9af-162a-5e50-b146-b4ba64b4b763`).

### Calculation:
$$\frac{\text{Total SG\&A expenses}}{\text{Net revenues}} = \frac{\$3,246.2\text{ million}}{\$6,355.3\text{ million}} \approx 51.079\% \rightarrow 51.1\%$$
